headline: Markets closed for weekend; Bank of India and Tata Motors release Q2 business updates

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Indian equity markets are closed today, Saturday, due to the weekend.
Trading will resume in the next regular trading session on Monday, 5 October.
Stock-specific action continues with Q2 business updates from key financial and auto sector players.
Global macroeconomic updates and trade discussions remain in focus over the weekend.
whatHappening: Bank of India reported Q2 global business nearing Rs 19 lakh crore with advances up 20%.
Tata Motors PV announced a 24.5% increase in JLR wholesale volumes, though retail sales saw a decline.
India's Gulf oil imports rose in September as suppliers navigated Hormuz trade risks.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted market fragmentation risks and urged greater global trade certainty.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 5 October. Key corporate highlights include Bank of India reporting a 20% jump in Q2 advances. Meanwhile, Tata Motors posted mixed JLR Q2 updates with strong wholesale growth offset by retail declines.
